commander.name: Pramikon, Sky Rampart
commander.oracle_text:
Flying, defender
As Pramikon enters, choose left or right.
Each player may attack only the nearest opponent in the chosen direction and planeswalkers controlled by that opponent.

themes.name: Great Wall of Dominaria
themes.pitch: Fill the board with Walls and high-toughness defenders, and let the thickest bulwark at the table win the long game.

themes.name: Velvet Rope of Three Colors
themes.pitch: Tax, tap and freeze anything that tries to get past your gatekeeper, so your opponents are stuck until you say otherwise.

themes.name: Pillow Fort Panic Room
themes.pitch: Shield your board with protection, reset the table with wipes when needed, and gain life while everyone else fumbles.

themes.name: Walkers Behind the Wall
themes.pitch: Planeswalkers tick up in safety while Pramikon narrows who is allowed to reach them.

themes.name: Diplomatic Immunity
themes.pitch: Hand out gifts and broker deals with the neighbor you point everyone at, and stay the friendliest face at the table.

themes.name: Draw-Go From the Ramparts
themes.pitch: Hold up counters and flash tricks behind a flying wall, and fire off spells at instant speed as the table's attacks stall.
